title: DECK on Sale!
speaker: Brad (ShadowTrader)

macro_themes.view: With AI and tech getting crushed, defensive/consumer names like Pepsi and McDonald's have rallied; look outside tech.

calls.condition: If DECK holds 77-78 on Monday and buyers come in, sell the Oct 30 77/78 put; if it gaps below the lows and stays there, do nothing.
calls.reason: Post-earnings drop to multi-year support at 77-78, about 65% below its 2-year high, heading into the holiday season.
calls.quote: I think Deckers uh presents a pretty decent opportunity at these levels given that we are coming into the holidays.

notes: Recorded Friday Oct 23 a little after 9:00 (ET, before the open); published Sunday Oct 25. Bullish expression is selling a cash-secured put, not buying stock. 85 was the prior close, used here as overhead reference.
